horizontal: ENU tangent plane at the origin on GRS80 (geodetic -> ECEF -> ENU, ECEF origin evaluated at horizontal_origin_height_m); x east, y north; no curvature term. Origin CRS EPSG:6668 (JGD2011 geographic 2D) and source CRS EPSG:6697 (JGD2011 geographic 2D + JGD2011 height) share the JGD2011 horizontal datum on GRS80, so the source latitude/longitude are used as published with no horizontal transformation and no translation from any other frame
vertical: none: no vertical datum and origin.hM is null on purpose. The frame defines x/y only. Each context feature is flattened to symbolic street z = 0 by subtracting its own ground height (its CityGML ground-height attribute when it carries one, else the minimum source height of the LOD geometry actually drawn for that feature; never one constant for all features): z_local = z_source - groundHeight(feature). Source heights are EPSG:6697 orthometric (TP) and are only ever used as differences within one feature.
axis_order: source latitude,longitude,height; station x east, y north, z up; glTF (renderer) x east, y up, z -north
purpose: Station reference frame (docs/core/contract.md Frames) for visual-only context geometry; NOT an envelope processing origin and NOT a routing frame
